To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the food web structure and dynamics in marine ecosystem models are strongly influenced by the choice of zooplankters and their interactions, and that the zooplankters are a weakly constrained part of these models.

the food web structure and dynamics are driven by the equation and parameter choice, which defines the interactions between the PFTs and ultimately the food web dynamics (bottom up or top down control, competition, predation).
The choice of equations and parameters in DGOMs determines the food web structure and dynamics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of zoopankton in marine food webs.
how the food web structure and dynamics is defined by the equations and parameters of DGOMs.
the importance of food web dynamics in DGOMs and how they influence ecosystem structure and function.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the choice of the model equations and parameters determines the food web interactions, which in turn determine the food web structure and dynamics.
the food webs are driven by the parameters and equations that define the interactions between the planktonic groups and the way they interact.
the food web structure and dynamics of a model are driven by the equation and parameter choice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
zooplankton is a key player in the planktonic community.
the choice of parameters, equations and PFTs in DGOMs can lead to very different food web dynamics and structures.
the food web structure is defined by the equations that are used in the model, and that the parameters that are used to define the equations have a strong effect on the dynamics of the food web.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the food web structure and dynamics in marine ecosystem models are not as robust as they seem and that the food web interactions need to be better quantified in order to better understand the dynamics of the ocean.
the choice of equations and parameters in DGOMs is crucial for food web dynamics and that more effort should be put into quantifying zooplankton parameters and interactions.
the food web structure is not necessarily defined by the number of trophic levels, but by the way the zooplankters are represented and the way they interact with the phytoplankton community.
